notes: All three geo proxy endpoints (suggest/geocode/reverse) changed from Policies(CustomerOrStaff) to AllowAnonymous(). GeoRateLimiter gained TryAcquire(string key) + internal static DeriveAnonBucketId(string) — SHA-256 based hash with forced version-5 nibble (UUID string third group = '5') so it structurally cannot collide with UUIDv7 user ids. Geocode and Reverse endpoints gained an F1 short-circuit: when FleetId == Guid.Empty (no resolvable fleet), return 200 Found=false without calling GeoService, preventing FK violation in the geo_cache/geo_usage tables. Suggest has no short-circuit (GeoService.SuggestAsync already bypasses cache on Guid.Empty). Existing tests updated: Suggest_Driver_Returns403 in SuggestAccessTests/RouteAccessTests and Suggest_NonDispatcher_Returns403 in GeoProxyTests all inverted to 200 (AllowAnonymous removes role constraint). docs/api.md regenerated by OpenAPI sibling test. All new anonymous shared-factory tests call rateLimiter.Reset() before each test to prevent shared-singleton bucket contamination. RED observed: (1) initial auth change caused 7 existing tests to fail 401→200 before new tests existed; (2) F1 RED confirmed by temporarily commenting out short-circuit in GeocodeEndpoint — Geocode_Anonymous_NoFleetSlug_DegradesFoundFalse went RED with Found=true leaking through the positive FakeGeoService result. Note: staged tree includes pre-existing non-WI-1 changes (launchSettings.json, README.md, designer/reviewer/pipeline handoffs, spec .md files) that predate this WI.
